page.layout: One page of text in a single column of verb paradigms, with side notes in the right margin. Running head at top with page number 77. Handwriting at the top is not transcribed.
page.notes: The Greek forms are in a distorted printed type; several letters (notably the initial letters of the verb stems and the accents) are uncertain and were copied as best seen. No [?] marks were added to individual forms because the type is consistent, but the Greek should be checked against a clearer copy. The handwriting at the top of the page is excluded.
